name: vendor.openwop-app.forms.agents
description: Forms feature agent pack — a manifest agent whose tools are feature.forms.nodes over the ctx.features.forms surface. Summarizes captured submissions into lead insights; tool-allowlisted to the Forms feature surface only, and READ-ONLY (it reports, it does not mutate). Treats a CRM-linked contactId as an optional signal, not a presumed outcome (ADR 0330). Mirrors vendor.openwop-app.kb.agents.
author: OpenWOP App

agents.label: Forms Lead Insights
agents.description: Summarizes a form's captured submissions into lead insights — volume, common answers, and follow-up suggestions — grounded via the openwop:forms.list-forms / openwop:forms.list-submissions chat tools. Read-only: it reports, it never edits forms or contacts.
